propositions: Packaged prose guides cite criterion ids inline but have no mechanism to detect when a criterion's authoritative text drifts from the guide's paraphrase of it, allowing semantic contradictions to ship silently for weeks.

A citation-pin manifest (derived from criterion registry text digests) regenerated in-place enables a parity gate to detect criterion text changes and force re-verification of guide claims without mechanically regenerating the prose itself.

The gate extracts citations by vocabulary-only matching against the closed criterion-id set, depending on no guide markup or structure, so ordinary prose edits and restructures do not trigger false failures.

The gate reports four failure modes: unknown citation (id absent from registry), stale pin (criterion text changed), orphan pin (id no longer cited), and missing manifest, each with a remediation path.
Integration into existing validate-routing composition avoids new CI steps, and a new module avoids exceeding the 800-LOC file size cap.
